source.title: Rank-1 Refulgent Copper Ore current-patch original-cast search audit

notes: T0003: No new independent post-2026-03-31 study was recovered that explicitly identifies rank-1 Refulgent Copper Ore item 237359 and gives verified completed prospect casts plus output-specific hit counts or histograms. JD3K's 50-ore test is explicitly quality 2, not 237359; Honeybone's 1000-ore/200-prospect April cohort does not state ore rank, and the March 26 200-ore/40-cast forum report is pre-hotfix with unmapped gem outputs. Existing studies and reposts were not duplicated. A search failure does not imply zero yields or non-eligibility. The 166-bracket disenchanting claim in TheWoWDB is a separate unverified mechanics lead for Master, not a source of per-item observed yields.
